component.name: Pixelift
component.summary: Make images larger and sharper with AI, locally

description.p: Upscale photos and illustrations 2× or 4× with Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, and restore old photographs. All processing happens on your computer: your images are never uploaded.

ul.li: Batch processing with pause, resume, cancel and retry
Before/after comparison with zoom and pan
NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm and Intel XPU acceleration with automatic CPU fallback
Tiled processing for very large images
Lighting profiles with a live preview
Camera-inspired looks (camera picture styles, film stocks, black and white) with intensity, film grain and skin-tone protection
AI photo restoration: dust, scratches, fading, colour casts and faces, with optional colorization of black-and-white photos
Keeps transparency, colour profiles and EXIF metadata

description.p: A redesigned window built around your photo: a large workspace with the lighting and camera look previewed live, a collapsible photo sidebar, and a calm dock with Enhance, Light, Look and Export tabs that open only when you need them.

Camera Looks: 30 camera- and film-inspired renderings with intensity, film grain, skin-tone protection, favorites and your own saved looks, previewed on your photo. The looks are Pixelift's own interpretations, not official manufacturer presets.

AI Photo Restoration: repair dust, scratches, noise and fading, correct yellowing and colour casts, restore faces while keeping the person's identity, and optionally colorize black-and-white photos — all locally.
Lighting profiles: adjust exposure, contrast, colour and more before upscaling, with a live preview.
